ingredientSections.heading: Duck Sliders
items: 6 White butter topped buns (or slider buns)
Canned or home poached sliced pears
Stonewall Kitchen Hot Pepper Spread (or similar hot pepper jelly)
German Cambozola Cheese or Blue Costello or similar soft slightly blue cheese
Grape seed oil, lemon-salt and pepper

methodSections.heading: Duck Sliders
steps: Marinate the duck breast in the orange juice and ground ginger overnight or for at least 8 hours.

Score fatty side of the duck breast being careful not to cut through to the meat. Season well with salt and pepper. Place in an oven preheated to 230°C (450°F) for roughly 30 minutes depending on the breast size. It should still be pink in the middle. Let rest for at least 15 minutes.
Crisp prosciutto in the oven. Toss the arugula with the grape seed oil, lemon-salt and pepper.
Place a teaspoon each of the mayonnaise, pepper jelly and caramelized onions on each bun and a nice slice of pear.
Slice the duck thinly and place on the pear. Top the duck with a slice of the cheese. Break up the prosciutto and layer a few pieces on the cheese before topping with a small ball of arugula.
